fr_html:
„La Cour exerce normalement ses attributions...“

Comme alternative M. Ricci-Busatti propose d'ajouter au commencement de cet alinéa:

„Sauf le cas prévu à l'article 24, la Cour exerce...“
en_html:
“The Court shall normally exercise its powers...”

As an alternative, he suggested the following addition at the commencement of the Paragraph:

“Except as provided in Article 24, the Court shall exercise...”
